decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The two-storey side and rear wraparound extension, by reason of its height, bulk and proximity to the adjoining properties, would represent an obtrusive and unneighbourly overdevelopment, which would harm the living conditions of the adjoining neighbours, by reason of enclosure, shading, and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The two-storey side and rear wraparound extension, by reason of its position, excessive bulk, and the lack of a 1m setback, would fail to be subordinate to the proportions of the original house, would unbalance the original pair of semi-detached houses and would harm the appearance of the street scene, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of two storey side extension, part two storey part single storey rear extension and erection of rear roof extension to house.
